card.name: Salamangreat Sanctuary
card.desc: If you Link Summon a "Salamangreat" Link Monster, you can use 1 "Salamangreat" Link Monster you control with its same name as the entire material. During damage calculation, if your monster battles: You can pay 1000 LP, then target 1 Link Monster you control; make its ATK 0, and if you do, gain LP equal to its original ATK. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Sanctuary" once per turn.

card.name: Salamangreat Roar
card.desc: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated while you control a "Salamangreat" Link Monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. While this card is in the GY, if a "Salamangreat" Link Monster is Link Summoned to your field using a monster with its same name as material: You can Set this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use 1 "Salamangreat Roar" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

While this card is in the GY, if a "Salamangreat" Link Monster is Link Summoned to your field using a monster with its same name as material: You can Set this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use 1 "Salamangreat Roar" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

main.name: Aitsu
main.desc: He seems to be very unreliable, but he might have incredible potential.

main.name: Ally of Justice Clausolas
main.desc: A mighty monster in Mist Valley, and the ultimate weapon designed from Claiomh Solais. Its surprise attacks from above baffle invaders.

main.name: Amphibian Beast
main.desc: On land or in the sea, the speed of this monster is unmatchable.

main.name: Ancient One of the Deep Forest
main.desc: This creature adopts the form of a white goat living in the forest, but is actually a Forest Elder.
main.canonicalName: Ancient One of the Deep Forest

main.name: Ancient Tool
main.desc: A destructive machine discovered in the Ruins of the Ancients.

main.name: Anotherverse Dragon
main.desc: This secretive dragon has conquered many dimensions, but can only be seen by the champion of time.

main.name: Ansatsu
main.desc: A silent and deadly warrior specializing in assassinations.

main.name: Battle Steer
main.desc: A bull monster often found in the woods, it charges enemy monsters with a pair of deadly horns.

main.name: Beast of Talwar
main.desc:
Only the master of the sword among Fiend-Type monsters is permitted to hold the Talwar.

(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)

main.name: Big Koala
main.desc: A species of huge Des Koala. He's meek, but people are afraid of him because he's very powerful.

main.name: Blue-Eyes White Dragon
main.desc: This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.

main.name: Bottom Dweller
main.desc: This is one sea creature whose wrath is something monsters fear to face.

extra.name: Salamangreat Balelynx
extra.desc:
1 Level 4 or lower Cyberse monster
If this card is Link Summoned: You can add 1 "Salamangreat Sanctuary" from your Deck to your hand. If a "Salamangreat" card(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Balelynx" once per turn.

extra.name: Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf
extra.desc:
2 FIRE Effect Monsters
If a monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned to the zone(s) this card points to (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 FIRE monster from your GY to your hand, but for the rest of this turn, you cannot Normal Summon/Set or Special Summon monsters with the same name as the monster added to your hand. During your Main Phase, if you control this card that was Link Summoned using "Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf" as material: You can add 1 "Salamangreat" Spell/Trap from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf" once per turn.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

main.name: Salamangreat Sanctuary
main.desc: If you Link Summon a "Salamangreat" Link Monster, you can use 1 "Salamangreat" Link Monster you control with its same name as the entire material. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Sanctuary" once per turn.

main.name: Salamangreat Roar
main.desc: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated while you control a "Salamangreat" Link Monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. You can only use 1 "Salamangreat Roar" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

card.name: Salamangreat Sanctuary
card.desc: If you Link Summon a "Salamangreat" Link Monster, you can use 1 "Salamangreat" Link Monster you control with its same name as the entire material. During damage calculation, if your monster battles: You can pay 1000 LP, then target 1 Link Monster you control; make its ATK 0, and if you do, gain LP equal to its original ATK. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Sanctuary" once per turn.

card.name: Salamangreat Roar
card.desc: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated while you control a "Salamangreat" Link Monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. While this card is in the GY, if a "Salamangreat" Link Monster is Link Summoned to your field using a monster with its same name as material: You can Set this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use 1 "Salamangreat Roar" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

extra.name: Salamangreat Balelynx
extra.desc:
1 Level 4 or lower Cyberse monster
If this card is Link Summoned: You can add 1 "Salamangreat Sanctuary" from your Deck to your hand. If a "Salamangreat" card(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Balelynx" once per turn.

extra.name: Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf
extra.desc:
2 FIRE Effect Monsters
If a monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned to the zone(s) this card points to (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 FIRE monster from your GY to your hand, but for the rest of this turn, you cannot Normal Summon/Set or Special Summon monsters with the same name as the monster added to your hand. During your Main Phase, if you control this card that was Link Summoned using "Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf" as material: You can add 1 "Salamangreat" Spell/Trap from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf" once per turn.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

main.name: Salamangreat Spinny

If you control a "Salamangreat" monster other than "Salamangreat Spinny" and this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Spinny" once per turn.

main.name: Salamangreat Sanctuary
main.desc: If you Link Summon a "Salamangreat" Link Monster, you can use 1 "Salamangreat" Link Monster you control with its same name as the entire material. During damage calculation, if your monster battles: You can pay 1000 LP, then target 1 Link Monster you control; make its ATK 0, and if you do, gain LP equal to its original ATK. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Sanctuary" once per turn.

main.name: Salamangreat Roar
main.desc: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated while you control a "Salamangreat" Link Monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. While this card is in the GY, if a "Salamangreat" Link Monster is Link Summoned to your field using a monster with its same name as material: You can Set this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use 1 "Salamangreat Roar" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

card.desc: If you Link Summon a "Salamangreat" Link Monster, you can use 1 "Salamangreat" Link Monster you control with its same name as the entire material. card.name: Salamangreat Roar
card.desc: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated while you control a "Salamangreat" Link Monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. You can only use 1 "Salamangreat Roar" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

extra.desc:
2 FIRE Effect Monsters
If a monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned to the zone(s) this card points to (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 FIRE monster from your GY to your hand, but for the rest of this turn, you cannot Normal Summon/Set or Special Summon monsters with the same name as the monster added to your hand. During your Main Phase, if you control this card that was Link Summoned using "Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf" as material: You can add 1 "Salamangreat" Spell/Trap from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf" once per turn.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

card.desc: A rare rainbow fish that has never been caught by mortal man.

card.name: Acrobat Monkey
card.desc: An autonomous monkey type robot which was developed with cutting-edge technology. It moves very acrobatically.

card.name: Alien Shocktrooper
card.desc: The Aliens have used a mysterious biological substance to create a supreme race of soldiers. They do not have the natural powers of the other Aliens, but can make stunning physical attacks.

card.name: Alinsection
card.desc: A stag beetle with a saw-like head and arms.

main.name: Salamangreat Gazelle
main.desc: If a "Salamangreat" monster is sent to your GY, except "Salamangreat Gazelle" (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 "Salamangreat" card from your Deck to the GY, except "Salamangreat Gazelle". You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Gazelle" once per turn.

main.name: Salamangreat Spinny
main.desc: If you control a "Salamangreat" card: You can discard this card, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. If you control a "Salamangreat" monster other than "Salamangreat Spinny" and this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Spinny" once per turn.

main.name: Salamangreat Sanctuary
main.desc: If you Link Summon a "Salamangreat" Link Monster, you can use 1 "Salamangreat" Link Monster you control with its same name as the entire material. During damage calculation, if your monster battles: You can pay 1000 LP, then target 1 Link Monster you control; make its ATK 0, and if you do, gain LP equal to its original ATK. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Sanctuary" once per turn.

main.name: Salamangreat Roar
main.desc: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated while you control a "Salamangreat" Link Monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. While this card is in the GY, if a "Salamangreat" Link Monster is Link Summoned to your field using a monster with its same name as material: You can Set this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use 1 "Salamangreat Roar" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

main.name: Aitsu
main.desc: He seems to be very unreliable, but he might have incredible potential.

main.name: Ally of Justice Clausolas
main.desc: A mighty monster in Mist Valley, and the ultimate weapon designed from Claiomh Solais. Its surprise attacks from above baffle invaders.

main.name: Amphibian Beast
main.desc: On land or in the sea, the speed of this monster is unmatchable.

main.name: Ancient One of the Deep Forest
main.desc: This creature adopts the form of a white goat living in the forest, but is actually a Forest Elder.
main.canonicalName: Ancient One of the Deep Forest

main.name: Ancient Tool
main.desc: A destructive machine discovered in the Ruins of the Ancients.

main.name: Anotherverse Dragon
main.desc: This secretive dragon has conquered many dimensions, but can only be seen by the champion of time.

main.name: Ansatsu
main.desc: A silent and deadly warrior specializing in assassinations.

main.name: Battle Steer
main.desc: A bull monster often found in the woods, it charges enemy monsters with a pair of deadly horns.

main.name: Beast of Talwar
main.desc:
Only the master of the sword among Fiend-Type monsters is permitted to hold the Talwar.

(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)

main.name: Big Koala
main.desc: A species of huge Des Koala. He's meek, but people are afraid of him because he's very powerful.

main.name: Blue-Eyes White Dragon
main.desc: This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.

main.name: Bottom Dweller
main.desc: This is one sea creature whose wrath is something monsters fear to face.

extra.name: Salamangreat Balelynx
extra.desc:
1 Level 4 or lower Cyberse monster
If this card is Link Summoned: You can add 1 "Salamangreat Sanctuary" from your Deck to your hand. If a "Salamangreat" card(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Balelynx" once per turn.

extra.name: Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf
extra.desc:
2 FIRE Effect Monsters
If a monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned to the zone(s) this card points to (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 FIRE monster from your GY to your hand, but for the rest of this turn, you cannot Normal Summon/Set or Special Summon monsters with the same name as the monster added to your hand. During your Main Phase, if you control this card that was Link Summoned using "Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf" as material: You can add 1 "Salamangreat" Spell/Trap from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf" once per turn.

If you control a "Salamangreat" monster other than "Salamangreat Spinny" and this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Spinny" once per turn.

main.name: Salamangreat Sanctuary
main.desc: If you Link Summon a "Salamangreat" Link Monster, you can use 1 "Salamangreat" Link Monster you control with its same name as the entire material. During damage calculation, if your monster battles: You can pay 1000 LP, then target 1 Link Monster you control; make its ATK 0, and if you do, gain LP equal to its original ATK. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Sanctuary" once per turn.

main.name: Salamangreat Roar
main.desc: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated while you control a "Salamangreat" Link Monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. While this card is in the GY, if a "Salamangreat" Link Monster is Link Summoned to your field using a monster with its same name as material: You can Set this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use 1 "Salamangreat Roar" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

main.name: Aitsu
main.desc: He seems to be very unreliable, but he might have incredible potential.

main.name: Ally of Justice Clausolas
main.desc: A mighty monster in Mist Valley, and the ultimate weapon designed from Claiomh Solais. Its surprise attacks from above baffle invaders.

main.name: Amphibian Beast
main.desc: On land or in the sea, the speed of this monster is unmatchable.

main.name: Ancient One of the Deep Forest
main.desc: This creature adopts the form of a white goat living in the forest, but is actually a Forest Elder.
main.canonicalName: Ancient One of the Deep Forest

main.name: Ancient Tool
main.desc: A destructive machine discovered in the Ruins of the Ancients.

main.name: Anotherverse Dragon
main.desc: This secretive dragon has conquered many dimensions, but can only be seen by the champion of time.

main.name: Ansatsu
main.desc: A silent and deadly warrior specializing in assassinations.

main.name: Battle Steer
main.desc: A bull monster often found in the woods, it charges enemy monsters with a pair of deadly horns.

main.name: Beast of Talwar
main.desc:
Only the master of the sword among Fiend-Type monsters is permitted to hold the Talwar.

(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)

main.name: Big Koala
main.desc: A species of huge Des Koala. He's meek, but people are afraid of him because he's very powerful.

main.name: Blue-Eyes White Dragon
main.desc: This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.

main.name: Bottom Dweller
main.desc: This is one sea creature whose wrath is something monsters fear to face.

extra.name: Salamangreat Balelynx
extra.desc:
1 Level 4 or lower Cyberse monster
If this card is Link Summoned: You can add 1 "Salamangreat Sanctuary" from your Deck to your hand. If a "Salamangreat" card(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Balelynx" once per turn.

extra.name: Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf
extra.desc:
2 FIRE Effect Monsters
If a monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned to the zone(s) this card points to (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 FIRE monster from your GY to your hand, but for the rest of this turn, you cannot Normal Summon/Set or Special Summon monsters with the same name as the monster added to your hand. During your Main Phase, if you control this card that was Link Summoned using "Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf" as material: You can add 1 "Salamangreat" Spell/Trap from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf" once per turn.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Spinny" once per turn.

main.name: Salamangreat Sanctuary
main.desc: If you Link Summon a "Salamangreat" Link Monster, you can use 1 "Salamangreat" Link Monster you control with its same name as the entire material. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Sanctuary" once per turn.

main.name: Salamangreat Roar
main.desc: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated while you control a "Salamangreat" Link Monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. You can only use 1 "Salamangreat Roar" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

main.desc: He seems to be very unreliable, but he might have incredible potential.

main.name: Ally of Justice Clausolas
main.desc: A mighty monster in Mist Valley, and the ultimate weapon designed from Claiomh Solais. Its surprise attacks from above baffle invaders.

main.name: Amphibian Beast
main.desc: On land or in the sea, the speed of this monster is unmatchable.

main.name: Ancient Tool
main.desc: A destructive machine discovered in the Ruins of the Ancients.

main.name: Anotherverse Dragon
main.desc: This secretive dragon has conquered many dimensions, but can only be seen by the champion of time.

main.name: Ansatsu

main.name: Battle Steer

Only the master of the sword among Fiend-Type monsters is permitted to hold the Talwar.

main.name: Blue-Eyes White Dragon
main.desc: This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.

main.name: Bottom Dweller
main.desc: This is one sea creature whose wrath is something monsters fear to face.

main.name: Salamangreat Gazelle

main.name: Salamangreat Spinny

If you control a "Salamangreat" monster other than "Salamangreat Spinny" and this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Spinny" once per turn.

main.name: Salamangreat Sanctuary
main.desc: If you Link Summon a "Salamangreat" Link Monster, you can use 1 "Salamangreat" Link Monster you control with its same name as the entire material. During damage calculation, if your monster battles: You can pay 1000 LP, then target 1 Link Monster you control; make its ATK 0, and if you do, gain LP equal to its original ATK. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Sanctuary" once per turn.

main.name: Salamangreat Roar
main.desc: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated while you control a "Salamangreat" Link Monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. While this card is in the GY, if a "Salamangreat" Link Monster is Link Summoned to your field using a monster with its same name as material: You can Set this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use 1 "Salamangreat Roar" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

extra.name: Salamangreat Balelynx
extra.desc:
1 Level 4 or lower Cyberse monster
If this card is Link Summoned: You can add 1 "Salamangreat Sanctuary" from your Deck to your hand. If a "Salamangreat" card(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Balelynx" once per turn.

extra.name: Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf
extra.desc:
2 FIRE Effect Monsters
If a monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned to the zone(s) this card points to (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 FIRE monster from your GY to your hand, but for the rest of this turn, you cannot Normal Summon/Set or Special Summon monsters with the same name as the monster added to your hand. During your Main Phase, if you control this card that was Link Summoned using "Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf" as material: You can add 1 "Salamangreat" Spell/Trap from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf" once per turn.

card.name: Salamangreat Sanctuary
card.desc: If you Link Summon a "Salamangreat" Link Monster, you can use 1 "Salamangreat" Link Monster you control with its same name as the entire material. During damage calculation, if your monster battles: You can pay 1000 LP, then target 1 Link Monster you control; make its ATK 0, and if you do, gain LP equal to its original ATK. main.name: Salamangreat Gazelle
main.desc: If a "Salamangreat" monster is sent to your GY, except "Salamangreat Gazelle" (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 "Salamangreat" card from your Deck to the GY, except "Salamangreat Gazelle". You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Gazelle" once per turn.

main.name: Salamangreat Spinny
main.desc: If you control a "Salamangreat" card: You can discard this card, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. If you control a "Salamangreat" monster other than "Salamangreat Spinny" and this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Spinny" once per turn.

main.name: Salamangreat Sanctuary
main.desc: If you Link Summon a "Salamangreat" Link Monster, you can use 1 "Salamangreat" Link Monster you control with its same name as the entire material. During damage calculation, if your monster battles: You can pay 1000 LP, then target 1 Link Monster you control; make its ATK 0, and if you do, gain LP equal to its original ATK. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Sanctuary" once per turn.

main.name: Salamangreat Roar
main.desc: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated while you control a "Salamangreat" Link Monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. While this card is in the GY, if a "Salamangreat" Link Monster is Link Summoned to your field using a monster with its same name as material: You can Set this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use 1 "Salamangreat Roar" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

main.desc: If a "Salamangreat" monster is sent to your GY, except "Salamangreat Gazelle" (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 "Salamangreat" card from your Deck to the GY, except "Salamangreat Gazelle". You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Gazelle" once per turn.

main.name: Salamangreat Spinny
main.desc: If you control a "Salamangreat" card: You can discard this card, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. If you control a "Salamangreat" monster other than "Salamangreat Spinny" and this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Spinny" once per turn.

main.name: Salamangreat Sanctuary
main.desc: If you Link Summon a "Salamangreat" Link Monster, you can use 1 "Salamangreat" Link Monster you control with its same name as the entire material. During damage calculation, if your monster battles: You can pay 1000 LP, then target 1 Link Monster you control; make its ATK 0, and if you do, gain LP equal to its original ATK. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Sanctuary" once per turn.

main.name: Salamangreat Roar
main.desc: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated while you control a "Salamangreat" Link Monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. While this card is in the GY, if a "Salamangreat" Link Monster is Link Summoned to your field using a monster with its same name as material: You can Set this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use 1 "Salamangreat Roar" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

main.name: Aitsu
main.desc: He seems to be very unreliable, but he might have incredible potential.

main.name: Ally of Justice Clausolas
main.desc: A mighty monster in Mist Valley, and the ultimate weapon designed from Claiomh Solais. Its surprise attacks from above baffle invaders.

main.name: Amphibian Beast
main.desc: On land or in the sea, the speed of this monster is unmatchable.

main.name: Ancient One of the Deep Forest
main.desc: This creature adopts the form of a white goat living in the forest, but is actually a Forest Elder.
main.canonicalName: Ancient One of the Deep Forest

main.name: Ancient Tool
main.desc: A destructive machine discovered in the Ruins of the Ancients.

main.name: Anotherverse Dragon
main.desc: This secretive dragon has conquered many dimensions, but can only be seen by the champion of time.

main.name: Ansatsu
main.desc: A silent and deadly warrior specializing in assassinations.

main.name: Battle Steer
main.desc: A bull monster often found in the woods, it charges enemy monsters with a pair of deadly horns.

main.name: Beast of Talwar
main.desc:
Only the master of the sword among Fiend-Type monsters is permitted to hold the Talwar.

(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)

main.name: Big Koala
main.desc: A species of huge Des Koala. He's meek, but people are afraid of him because he's very powerful.

main.name: Blue-Eyes White Dragon
main.desc: This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.

main.name: Bottom Dweller
main.desc: This is one sea creature whose wrath is something monsters fear to face.

extra.name: Salamangreat Balelynx
extra.desc:
1 Level 4 or lower Cyberse monster
If this card is Link Summoned: You can add 1 "Salamangreat Sanctuary" from your Deck to your hand. If a "Salamangreat" card(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Balelynx" once per turn.

extra.name: Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf
extra.desc:
2 FIRE Effect Monsters
If a monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned to the zone(s) this card points to (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 FIRE monster from your GY to your hand, but for the rest of this turn, you cannot Normal Summon/Set or Special Summon monsters with the same name as the monster added to your hand. During your Main Phase, if you control this card that was Link Summoned using "Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf" as material: You can add 1 "Salamangreat" Spell/Trap from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf" once per turn.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

main.name: Salamangreat Gazelle
main.desc: If a "Salamangreat" monster is sent to your GY, except "Salamangreat Gazelle" (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 "Salamangreat" card from your Deck to the GY, except "Salamangreat Gazelle". You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Gazelle" once per turn.

main.name: Salamangreat Spinny
main.desc: If you control a "Salamangreat" card: You can discard this card, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. If you control a "Salamangreat" monster other than "Salamangreat Spinny" and this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Spinny" once per turn.

main.name: Salamangreat Sanctuary
main.desc: If you Link Summon a "Salamangreat" Link Monster, you can use 1 "Salamangreat" Link Monster you control with its same name as the entire material. During damage calculation, if your monster battles: You can pay 1000 LP, then target 1 Link Monster you control; make its ATK 0, and if you do, gain LP equal to its original ATK. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Sanctuary" once per turn.

main.name: Salamangreat Roar
main.desc: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated while you control a "Salamangreat" Link Monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. While this card is in the GY, if a "Salamangreat" Link Monster is Link Summoned to your field using a monster with its same name as material: You can Set this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use 1 "Salamangreat Roar" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

main.desc: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated while you control a "Salamangreat" Link Monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. main.desc: He seems to be very unreliable, but he might have incredible potential.

card.name: Salamangreat Sanctuary
card.desc: If you Link Summon a "Salamangreat" Link Monster, you can use 1 "Salamangreat" Link Monster you control with its same name as the entire material. During damage calculation, if your monster battles: You can pay 1000 LP, then target 1 Link Monster you control; make its ATK 0, and if you do, gain LP equal to its original ATK.
